title: Domain-Tuned Diffusion Super-Resolution for 4K Facial Asset Maps
abstract: arXiv:2611.21890v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Physically based facial assets require 4K albedo and displacement maps for cinematic close-ups, yet generative pipelines commonly produce them at only 1K. Naively applying photographic super-resolution is a poor fit: facial UV maps have domain-specific statistics, and displacement is a scalar height field whose errors directly distort geometry. We present a domain-tuned diffusion upscaler for 4x (1024 to 4096) facial asset super-resolution. Starting from a bilinearly upsampled map, we adapt a frozen SDXL backbone per modality with lightweight LoRA modules, while a Tile ControlNet preserves input structure as the diffusion prior restores pore- and wrinkle-scale detail. On held-out maps, our method produces sharper, more faithful detail than bilinear and off-the-shelf GAN and diffusion super-resolvers, reducing albedo LPIPS from 0.21 to 0.08 while avoiding misplaced or excessive displacement relief. translated_title: 面向4K面部资产贴图的领域微调扩散超分辨率方法
translated_abstract: 基于物理渲染的面部资产在电影级特写镜头中需要4K分辨率的反照率贴图和位移贴图，然而生成式流程通常只能产出1K分辨率的贴图。简单套用照片超分辨率方法并不适用：面部UV贴图具有特定领域的统计特性，而位移是一种标量高度场，其误差会直接导致几何形变。我们提出了一种针对4倍（1024到4096）面部资产超分辨率的领域微调扩散上采样器。从双线性上采样的贴图出发，我们针对每种模态使用轻量级LoRA模块对冻结的SDXL骨干网络进行适配，同时利用Tile ControlNet保持输入结构，由扩散先验恢复毛孔与皱纹级别的细节。在保留测试集上，我们的方法相比双线性插值以及现成的GAN和扩散超分辨率模型，生成了更清晰、更忠实的细节，将反照率LPIPS从0.21降低到0.08，同时避免了位移浮雕的错误错位或过度起伏。这些结果表明，轻量级领域微调……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出一种面向面部资产贴图的领域微调扩散上采样方法，通过轻量级LoRA适配冻结的SDXL骨干并结合Tile ControlNet保持结构，实现1024到4096的4倍超分辨率，将反照率LPIPS从0.21降至0.08且避免位移贴图的几何失真。
en_tdlr: We propose a domain-tuned diffusion upscaler for 4x facial asset map super-resolution (1024 to 4096) that adapts a frozen SDXL backbone with lightweight LoRA modules and preserves structure via a Tile ControlNet, reducing albedo LPIPS from 0.21 to 0.08 while avoiding misplaced or excessive displacement relief.
